scope: 1.1.2-debug FTDI Android driver integration and wake adaptation

source_observations.set_parameters: FT232R 10400 baud yields value 0x4120 and index 0; 8N1 yields data configuration 8
source_observations.set_break: FtdiSerialPort.setBreak adds flag 0x4000 to 8N1 configuration, using request 4 / port index 1
source_observations.receive: FtdiSerialPort.read supplies USB packets to the protected readFilter method
source_observations.purge: Version 3.12.0 purgeHwBuffers maps purgeWriteBuffers to RESET_PURGE_RX (1) and purgeReadBuffers to RESET_PURGE_TX (2); the application retains direct request 0/value 1 RX purge

original_hondaecu_reference.scope: Original pinned Windows HondaECU engine with a scripted FTDI handle; no physical hardware
original_hondaecu_reference.original_wake: setBitMode(1,1), write 00, 70 ms, write 01, setBitMode(0,0), setBaudRate(10400), 130 ms, purge
original_hondaecu_reference.android_adaptation: Use the serial driver's BREAK ON/OFF for the LOW/HIGH pulse; keep at least 70/130 ms and then wait for 24 ms RX quiet, bounded to 250 ms

driver_research.d2xx_distribution_limitation: The included driver license clauses 3.1.3 and 3.1.7 restrict incorporation into other programs and making the software available; this SDK was not bundled
driver_research.vendor_download_page: Returned HTTP 403 to the available noninteractive reader

physical_failure_target.power_description: User reports 12 V/GND on K-Line board, FTDI connected by GND/VCC/RX/TX and set to 5 V; precise power routing unknown
